{{See also|Radxa|List of SBCs}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Allwinner]] A527 [[ARM]] ([[big.LITTLE]]) :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55) @1.8GHz + :Quad-core ARM (Cortex-A55) @1.4GHz + :XuanTie E906 RISC-V core @ 200MHz :• NPU: 2 TOPS @INT8 :• Audio DSP: HIFI4 @ 600MHz :• GPU: ''Mali-G57 MC1'' (OpenGL ES3.2, OpenCL 2.0); :• VPU (with 4K @60fps H265/H264 decoding) *Storage: 16MB (SPI) Flash :TF card (max.64GB)/MMC card slot *Memory: 4GB (SDRAM) LPDDR4 *Wi-Fi: [[AIC]] AIC8800D80 ([[LB-LINK BL-M8800DS2]]) :802.11abgn/ac/ax (1T1R) + BT 5.4 Combo SiP Module *Network: 2x GbE port *USB: 1x USB 3.0, 1x USB 2.0 (Type-C) OTG ports *PCI: 1x PCIe 2.0 M.2 (M-Key) slot *GPIO: 1x 40-pin headers *Power: 5V/4A via USB (Type-C)
